record_layout: 64 little-endian FP32 inputs, one FP32 scale, 64 signed bytes

uniform_component_reconstruction_bound.definition: max_scale * (1/2 + 1/65536) includes at most 2^-17 clipping and 2^-17 quotient rounding

scope: Captured activation groups, with every logit hash matched to the retained compiled-model comparison. This checks local quantizer ranges and reconstruction conditions, not all nonlinear forward-propagation assumptions.
runtime_trust: Whole-file evaluation uses the pinned Lean native compiler and runtime. Soundness theorems are kernel checked.
